gpuIdentityNote: User-computer IAB rendered WebGL. The actual renderer/GPU was not identified; no 4080S attribution. Root cloud browser lacks usable WebGL, which is a separate environment.

supplement.vehicleState: Some city night frames inherit AIR STABILIZE H 3.1; position and state differ from first batch.

vehicleComparison.scope: 3.8 and 3.9 geometry/materials in the same 3.9 inspection rig; not different renderer engines.

corrections.earlierAX68Kmh: Not simultaneous with turn-before image; not a 68 km/h steering acceptance.
corrections.pausedScope: Approximately 30 Hz paused preview policy; not active-driving performance.
corrections.fpsScope: Driving/flight point HUD readings only, not a route distribution.
corrections.eqResponse: 3 and 8 m/s plus refresh persistence were actually checked by the user browser.
corrections.gLevel: UI changed to level mode, but a complete attitude/recovery time series was not captured.

comparisonLimits: Do not compare first and supplemental batches as a strict brightness or performance A/B.
Original stills do not include full per-frame metadata; reconstructing unknown state is not an exact comparison.
Current camera/vehicle/lighting/drawing-buffer conditions must be saved with each actual rendered frame.
Changing lighting presets is separate from a same-lighting geometry/material comparison.
Current source, offline shaders, mock DOM and geometry tests do not attest 3.10 pixel quality or FPS.
